title.zh: 手机版回来了：/m 子路径、155 个主题片段、手机壳判据与数据体检
title.en: The phone version returns: /m, 155 theme clips, phone-shell criteria and a data audit

highlights.zh: 导出音频时先说“正在准备乐器…”，首次反馈从 6.4 秒缩到 0.1 秒；随后仍是带预计剩余时间的百分比。
highlights.en: An audio export now says "Preparing instruments…" first: the first feedback moved from 6.4 s to 0.1 s, and the percentage with its estimate still follows.

highlights.zh: 手机版以 /m 子路径回来：手机壳 40 个文件接回，编译与全部门禁通过；退役的 /m/<module> 保持退役。
highlights.en: The phone shell is back at /m: forty ported files, the compiler and every gate green, and the retired /m/<module> route stays retired.

highlights.zh: 155 个 15–30 秒主题片段，每个都用该曲风自己的音色/采样器（无一是全合成），音频放在 Cloudflare（不入 git），清单带版本与生成时间。
highlights.en: 155 clips of 15–30 seconds, each sounding through its genre's own instruments — none all-synth — served from Cloudflare rather than git, with the list carrying its version and date.
